title: Simple Calculator
description:
Read two numbers and an operator (`+`, `-`, `*`, `/`) from input. Perform the calculation and print the result rounded to 2 decimal places.

**Example (inputs: `12`, `4`, `*`):**
```
Result: 48.0
```
starterCode:
# Write your code here
a = float(input())
b = float(input())
op = input()
hint: Use if/elif to check which operator was entered and perform the right calculation.
